description: Defines classes and options for a faulty TensorPipe RPC agent used in distributed RPC testing, including options for message failure and delay, and the FaultyTensorPipeAgent class with methods for sending messages and injecting faults.

classes.name: FaultyTensorPipeRpcBackendOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for the faulty TensorPipe RPC backend, including message failure and delay settings.

classes.name: FaultyTensorPipeAgent
classes.description: A specialized TensorPipe RPC agent that can simulate message failures and delays for testing purposes.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message to a specified worker, with fault injection capabilities.

methods.name: pipeWrite
methods.description: Injects delay into pipe write operations.

methods.name: shouldFailMessage
methods.description: Determines whether a message of a certain type should fail based on configuration.

methods.name: parseMessagesToFailInput
methods.description: Parses input strings to identify message types that should fail.

methods.name: getDelayForMessage
methods.description: Returns delay duration for a specific message type.

methods.name: parseMessagesToDelay
methods.description: Parses message delay configurations into message type to delay mappings.

methods.name: messageStringToType
methods.description: Converts a message string to its corresponding MessageType enum.
